content.what_it_is: MATLAB script plotting FUNWAVE-TVD surface elevation snapshots for the inlet_shoal case. Loads bathymetry ../bathy/dep_shoal_inlet.txt (L4), builds grid with dx=dy=2.0 (L7-L10), defines sponge (x 0-180; L12-L13) and wavemaker (x 240-260; L14-L15) outlines. For each snapshot in nfile=[5 7] (L18) with corresponding time labels min={'200' '300'} seconds (L19), loads eta_ and mask_ files from fdir (L30-L31), masks dry cells via eta(mask==0)=NaN (L33), and plots each in a 1x2 subplot (L35): pcolor with flat shading (L37), caxis([-0.5 2]) (L39), title ' Time = <min> sec ' (L40), sponge outline green dashed with rotated white 'Sponge' text (L43-L45), wavemaker outline red with rotated white 'Wavemaker' text (L47-L49), ylabel only on the first panel (L51-L53), xlabel on both (L55). Colorbar (L56-L57) and jpeg print (L61) are commented out; figure is 8x5 inches (L21-L23).
entities: min cell array of time labels L19 (shadows builtin min)
unresolved: variable name min (L19) shadows the MATLAB builtin min within this script
time labels '200' and '300' sec are asserted for snapshots 5 and 7 (L18-L19, L40) but the output interval that would justify them is not in this file
the print command (L61) and colorbar (L56-L57) are commented out, so the script displays but saves nothing
commented print filename suffix _irr (L61) suggests an irregular-wave run; not confirmable from this file
